name: magnetic-hover-button
title: Magnetic Hover Button
description: A magnetic hover button leans toward the cursor while hovered and springs back to rest on leave: pointer position is normalized to -1..1, damped through a spring, and rendered as a CSS transform. An experimental showcase/marketing touch — never a product-wide button default. Keyboard users get the identical button minus the lean; reduced motion disables the pull entirely.
